''27. With v{{ls}}urie.''] V{{ls}}urie is here taken for the lawful gaine that a man getteth by wel employing his goods. When God geueth vs any talent or talents, he looketh for v{{ls}}urie, that is, for {{ls}}piritual increa{{ls}}e of the {{ls}}ame by our diligence and indu{{ls}}trie.

''32. Separate.''] {{outside L|Good and bad in the Church.}}Lo here is the {{ls}}eparation, for in the Church militant they liued both together. Come ye, 41 get ye away.''] {{outside L|Heauen is the reward of good workes, and Hel of the contrarie.}}It is no incongruity that God {{ls}}hould {{ls}}ay, Goe into euerla{{ls}}ting fire, to them that by their free wil haue repelled his mercie: and to the other, Come ye ble{{ls}}{{ls}}ed of my father, take the kingdom prepared for them, that by their free wil haue receiued faith, and confe{{ls}}{{ls}}ed their {{ls}}innes and done penance. ''Aug. li. 2 act. cum Fel. Manich. c. 8''.

''35. You gaue me.''] Hereby we {{ls}}ee how much almes-deedes and al workes of mercy preuaile towardes life euerla{{ls}}ting, and to blot out former {{ls}}innes. ''Aug. in P{{ls}}. 49''.

''42. Gaue me not.''] He chargeth them not here that they beleeued not, but that they did not good workes. For {{ls}}uch did beleeue, but they cared not for good workes, as though by dead faith they might haue come to heauen. ''Aug. de fid. & op. c. 15. & ad Dulcit. q. 2. to. 4''.
